canonical_project: Olkaria EcoCloud Data Centre / Project Eagle
owner: EcoCloud Data Centre; KenGen Green Energy Park host
notes: DCD reported EcoCloud broke ground on Project Eagle at KenGen Green Energy Park in Olkaria, Nakuru County. Phase one is described as 24MW IT capacity across eight 3MW data halls; article also says the facility is expected to consume 70MW and be powered by geothermal energy from KenGen.
